function.arguments: {"observation": "The `revenue` column contains strings with thousands separators (e.g., '1,234.56'), which will cause errors if used in numeric operations. The data dictionary warns this is due to Excel export.", "implication": "We must clean the `revenue` column by removing commas and converting to float before any numeric analysis. Although the current estimand (conversion fraction) does not depend on `revenue`, this cleaning is essential to avoid silent corruption if we later need to check for QA orders or other anomalies. Also, the QA order check (revenue = '999999.99') must be done on cleaned data. The presence of such orders would distort any revenue-based metric, so we must verify whether they are present after cleaning."}
function.name: note_finding
